Description
NABA is the largest private academy in Italy and is considered as one of the world’s top schools for art and design. It was included in the Masterclass Frame Guide to the 30 World’s Leading Graduate Design, Architecture and Fashion Design Schools and was chosen by Domus Magazine as one of the Europe’s Top 100 schools of Architecture and Design. The three-year Bachelor of Arts Degree Programs, the two-year Master of Arts Degree Programs and the one-year Academic Master Programs lead to the attainment of legally recognized degrees and to the achievement of educational credits that allow students to continue their studies in Italian and foreign academies and universities.
